generation.scope: The fifteen-dimensional component meets the entire quantum polynomial indexed family in exactly one class, its opposite-rank-twelve Walsh boundary. At any standard specialization with domain corner, the corner PI degree is exactly four: a discrete valuation with central uniformizer and residue characteristic zero preserves division degree. A quantum corner has PI degree equal to the order of the group of triangle parameters; among the 56 primitive fourth-root triples only one permutation orbit has the required five quartic central sections.
